deploybot: Deploy attempt blocked — environment=staging, ref=refs/tags/v0.21.4, commit=abcdef12, pipeline=ci/redwood/main/4567. CI gate failed: unit-tests (timeout), coverage-threshold (drop). Details: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4567

maya: @deploybot thanks — any quick pointers which checks failed? :eyes:

josh: unit-tests timed out on `tests/serving/test_kv_cache.py::test_eviction` — repeated flakes in logs. Also seeing a coverage delta: -0.6% on core/serving.

liam: coverage drop looks real in the coverage report (core/serving). Related to new cache instrumentation in this change. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/4567/coverage-report.html

maya: can we rerun the job first? /ci retry 4567 or manual retry would be less invasive. Change window open until 18:00 UTC.

eng-sre-bot: Rerun requested by @maya. Command executed: `/ci retry 4567` — new job 4568 queued.

deploybot: Rerun started (job 4568). Will post result.

josh: if rerun passes but coverage is still below threshold we need a plan. Do we want to temporarily relax threshold for staging?

liam: relaxing threshold is risky — compliance requires regression review. We should bisect to the offending commit or add a targeted test fix. ETA for triage ~45m.

deploybot: Rerun finished (job 4568) — unit-tests: PASSED, lint: PASSED, coverage-threshold: FAILED (delta -0.4%). Deploy remains BLOCKED. Failing check: coverage-threshold. Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4568

maya: noted. Marking release as blocked by coverage regression. Can we pin to previous tag v0.21.3 and proceed with rollback if needed? What's risk of skipping this deploy?

josh: There's a DB migration in this release that we haven't fully smoke-tested. Rolling back to v0.21.3 is safe but will delay the migration; might be acceptable if we need availability.

liam: I'll start a quick bisect to find the commit that caused coverage to drop. If it's a small test change we can revert. Starting now.

maya: Plan: hold staging deploy for manual triage. If we don't have a clear fix by 17:30 UTC, rollback/pin to v0.21.3 for the change window. Assigning @josh and @liam to triage.

eng-sre-bot: Action logged: triage ticket created RD-3421 (owner: josh, liam). :white_check_mark:

josh: quick log snippet from failing test run (4567):

```
E   TimeoutError: test_eviction exceeded 30s
/opt/ci/runner/work/redwood/core/serving/cache.py:182: in evict
assert len(cache) < capacity
```

liam: bisect update: narrowing to commit cdef345 -> causes coverage drop due to removed test helper. Opening quick PR to re-add helper and re-run. ETA ~25m.

maya: thanks. Hold all deploy actions until PR lands and CI green, or until rollback window triggers.

deploybot: Current state: BLOCKED (coverage-threshold). Waiting on triage/PR. Last status posted 2112224000.

eng-sre-bot: Reaction :thumbsup: from @josh and :hourglass_flowing_sand: from @liam
